definitions.explanation: A blood vessel that carries deoxygenated blood back to the heart.

examples.japanese: {静脈|じょうみゃく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{採血|さいけつ}→採血：11074_saiketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They draw blood from a vein.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静脈|じょうみゃく}{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→静脈注射：24680_joumyakuchuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{静脈|じょうみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}き→浮く：00413_uku⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The veins in my arm are visible.

notes:
{静脈|じょうみゃく} is the medical term for veins—blood vessels that carry deoxygenated blood back to the heart.

MEDICAL COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{静脈|じょうみゃく}{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→静脈注射：24680_joumyakuchuusha⟧: intravenous injection (IV)
- ⟦{静脈|じょうみゃく}{瘤|りゅう}→静脈瘤：noentry⟧: varicose veins
- ⟦{静脈|じょうみゃく}{血|けっ}{栓|せん}→静脈血栓：noentry⟧: venous thrombosis

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {静脈|じょうみゃく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{採血|さいけつ}→採血：11074_saiketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to draw blood from a vein
- {静脈|じょうみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}き→浮く：00413_uku⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: veins are visible/prominent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {静脈|じょうみゃく}: vein (carries blood TO the heart)
- ⟦{動脈|どうみゃく}→動脈：05857_doumyaku⟧: artery (carries blood FROM the heart)

WRITING:
⟦{静|せい}→静：noentry⟧ (quiet/still) + ⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧ (pulse/vein) - veins have less pressure than arteries.
